evidence: A Dyson cleaner head with a transparent roller cover, anti-tangle comb, and red quick-release collar is visible.
missing_evidence: The main vacuum body, dustbin orientation, handle controls, and cyclone assembly are out of frame.
decision.retake: Photograph the main handheld body showing the dustbin, handle, and controls.

candidate_checks.evidence: Motorbar cleaner heads are shared across Dyson ranges, and the perpendicular dustbin body is out of frame.
The main body with the CleanCompaktor mechanism is not visible to verify V16 identity.
The cleaner head alone cannot identify V15 without the in-line body or rear LCD screen.
The canister body and hose are out of frame to verify a Big Ball cylinder vacuum.
The slim motor body and push-button power control are out of frame.
The wet-cleaner body and dual-roller assembly are not visible to establish or rule out the family definitively.

o1.refinement_reason: Inspect the main vacuum body to see the dustbin layout and control interface.
